items.text:
This game isn't for everyone.

If you want a slow paced, deep(for its art-form) and unique experience then I highly reccomend this.
This is one of those few examples where the lines between "game" and interactive experience is virtually nonexistent.

In this game you don't controll the actions of the main character, you are simply in his head experiencing his situation, guiding his actions in very minimal ways. It's subtle and effective (If only the controlls were slightly improved).

I won't get in too much on the story, since it's quite short but complex, but it's basically about the experience of being stood up on a dinner date and the effect is has on a persons train of thoughts. The characters reactions are very relatable and it feels very natural and never forced.

However, despite the rich content the game is very short, I have yet to decide if the game would be better if it would reach perhaps the 30 minute mark or if it would feel dragged out, but it does leave you with a hunger for more and I expect many more games like this will reach the surface in the near future, because I think the concept alone is nothing but brilliant!
items.text_zh:
这款游戏并不适合所有人。

如果你想要一种慢节奏、深刻（就其艺术形式而言）且独特的体验，那么我强烈推荐这个。
这是少数几个“游戏”与互动体验之间界限几乎不存在的例子之一。

在这款游戏中，你并不控制主角的行动，你只是在他的脑海中体验他的处境，以非常微小的方式引导他的行动。这很微妙且有效（要是控制能稍微改进一下就好了）。

我不会过多涉及剧情，因为它相当短但复杂，但基本上是关于在晚餐约会中被放鸽子的体验，以及这对一个人思绪的影响。角色的反应非常能引起共鸣，感觉非常自然，从不勉强。

然而，尽管内容丰富，游戏却非常短，我还没决定如果游戏达到大约30分钟会更好，还是会让人觉得拖沓，但它确实让你渴望更多，我预计未来会有更多类似的游戏浮出水面，因为我认为仅这个概念就非常出色！

observations.evidence: If only the controlls were slightly improved
observations.evidence_zh: 要是操作能稍微改进一下就好了。
